headline: UK Inflation Rises to Annual High of 3.6% as Bank of England Eyes Hikes
summary: British annual inflation rose to a yearly high of 3.6%, prompting market participants to anticipate multiple interest rate hikes as the Bank of England projects inflation nearing 5%.
why: Stubbornly high inflation forces central banks to maintain or accelerate monetary tightening, influencing gilt yields and the British pound.

impacts.name: British Pound
impacts.why: Higher-than-expected inflation data increases expectations for aggressive Bank of England interest rate hikes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Accelerating price growth reinforced expectations of monetary policy tightening by the central bank.
